class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Where you can use the Gemini web app</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p>The Gemini web app is currently available in more than 70 languages and over 230 countries and territories.&nbsp;</p>

<p>We’ll gradually expand to more countries and territories in a way that's consistent with local regulations and our <a href="https://ai.google/principles/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">AI principles</a>.</p>

<p><strong>Important:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>The Gemini mobile app may have different availability.&nbsp; Learn more about&nbsp;the <a href="/gemini/answer/14579026" rel="noopener">supported languages and countries of the mobile app</a>.</li>
  <li>Learn more about eligibility and requirements to use <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">the Gemini web app</a> or <a href="/gemini/answer/14554984" rel="noopener">the Gemini mobile app</a>.</li>
</ul>
